claude_only.name: Which single identifier is the authoritative master reference for this payment, and which system of record assigns it?
How are initiating-party, instructing-agent, clearing-system and end-to-end references held distinct while remaining correlatable?
Who verifies that the end-to-end reference is unique, and what happens when uniqueness is only format-checked?
Which references must intermediaries pass through unaltered, and which may they replace on their own leg?
What instrument class and scheme does this payment belong to, and which rulebook version therefore governs it?
Which execution deadline, revocability rule and return right follow from the chosen classification rather than from party agreement?
On what basis was this scheme selected over an eligible alternative, and who made that choice?
How does this classification map onto an external payment method identifier used by an ordering channel?
Is the amount fixed at instruction time or determinable later, and what rule determines it?
How is the amount validated against the governed minor unit of its currency, and what is done with excess precision?
Where the settled amount differs from the instructed amount, what accounts for the difference?
Which party applied the exchange rate, from which quoting source, and at what quotation time?
Was the applicable rate disclosed to the payer before the order became irrevocable?
What margin separates the applied rate from the reference rate, and how is it attributed?
Which charge bearer arrangement applies, and does it permit deduction from the transferred principal?
Which agent levied each charge, in what amount and currency, and on which leg?
If charges were deducted in transit, is the underlying obligation still treated as discharged in the full instructed amount?
Which entity occupies each payment role, and does any entity occupy more than one role?
Do the ultimate debtor or ultimate creditor differ from the account-holding payer and payee, and why?
What is the ordered sequence of agents, and which agent is the sender and receiving bank on each hop?
On what authority does the initiating party act where it is not the payer itself?
What is the minimum party data set the selected rail requires, and is every mandatory element present?
Is the party address supplied in structured form, and which structured components are populated?
Which carried party attributes exceed what the rail requires, and on what basis are they transmitted?
Which identifier scheme is used to identify each party, and is the scheme externally governed?
Which supplied value is designated as the unique identifier by the provider, and which other account data is advisory only?
What happens when the account name and the unique identifier disagree, and who bears the resulting loss?
Was the identifier only structurally validated, or was existence and ownership confirmed with the receiving institution?
Which device or agreed procedure constitutes the payment instrument used here, and who issued it?
Which credential elements may be stored after authorisation, and which must never be retained?
What is the current state of the instrument, and does its expiry or suspension invalidate pending payments?
Which roles may resolve a stored token back to the underlying credential, and under what control?
In what agreed form was consent given, and does that form cover this specific payment or a series?
What authentication evidence exists to show the payer authorised this payment, and where is it retained?
Within what period may the payer still claim the payment was unauthorised, and when does that period start?
Was the order accepted, refused, held or declined, and which of these did the payer actually experience?
Was refusal notified within the applicable execution period, with reasons and correction instructions?
Where a screening hold prevents disclosure of the true reason, how is the tension with the duty to give reasons resolved?
What is the actual time the order reached the provider, and what is the deemed time of receipt after cut-off rules?
Did the parties agree a future execution date or a funds-availability trigger instead of immediate execution?
Whose business-day calendar governs, and how are divergent calendars across the agent chain reconciled?
At what precise moment does this payment become irrevocable, and what rule fixes that moment?
Is a scheme-specific revocation window still open, and who must consent to a late revocation?
Once irrevocable, what recall or return request may be raised and what is the receiver obliged to do?
Which fields of an accepted order may be amended without cancelling and reissuing it?
Which rail or correspondent chain carried this payment, and what alternatives were reachable?
Which settlement method applies between each pair of agents, and where does a cover payment run separately?
Which participant holds credit exposure to which other participant at each stage of the chain?
Where the payment crosses between rails or message standards, which fields are lost or truncated?
Did this payment settle individually on a gross basis or as part of a netted position, and in which cycle?
In which settlement asset was the obligation discharged between participants, and who issues that asset?
Was the payment queued or delayed for liquidity, and which liquidity-saving mechanism resolved it?
If a participant defaults mid-cycle, what happens to this payment under the system's default rules?
What execution deadline applied to this payment, and was it met measured from the deemed time of receipt?
How do the settlement timestamp, the credit value date and the time funds became available to the payee differ?
How much value-dating float arose between debit and credit, and to whom did the benefit accrue?
How is a settlement record confirmed as authoritative rather than provisional or inferred?
At what moment did this payment become final, and which system rule or legal rule fixes that moment?
Where the operational finality point and the legal moment of payment differ, which governs for which purpose?
Do any of the recognised exceptions prevent the underlying obligation from being discharged by this payment?
After finality, on what basis could funds still be recovered, and is that a reversal or a new payment?
Which participant reported this status, about which leg, and as at what moment?
Which code set does this status reason belong to, and what is its meaning in that set's version?
When two participants report conflicting statuses for the same payment, which is treated as authoritative?
What information is lost when a scheme reason code is mapped to an internal or customer-facing status?
What is the ordered sequence of lifecycle events for this payment, and how is ordering established across participants?
For each event, when did it occur on the rail and when was it observed or ingested here?
Which state transitions are permitted from the current state, and which observed transition was invalid?
What is the source and trust level of each recorded event, and was any event inferred rather than reported?
Which mechanism was used to move value back, and did it create a new payment or unwind the original?
What reason was cited for the return or recall, and was it raised within the scheme's permitted window?
Where a recall request was refused, on what ground, and what remedy remains to the requester?
How is a returned payment linked back to the original so that neither is double-counted?
Which event started the dispute or claim clock, and when does each applicable deadline expire?
Was provisional credit required, in what amount, and was it granted within the prescribed period?
Who bears the loss for this disputed payment, and which factor determined the allocation?
What evidence was gathered and disclosed to the claimant, and in what readable form?
Which obligations does this payment discharge, in what allocated amounts, and who decided the allocation?
What residual remains unallocated or unpaid after this payment, and how is it carried forward?
Under what conditions could this discharge be undone, and what would then revive the obligation?
What purpose and category purpose are declared for this payment, and who assigned them?
Does remittance information travel inside the payment or as a separate advice, and how are the two bound?
Where remittance data exceeds what a rail can carry, what is truncated and how is the loss signalled?
Which intermediaries can read the remittance content, and does it disclose commercially sensitive detail?
Which party issued each confirmation, advice or statement, and what does that party actually attest to?
How does a statement entry bind back to the payment, and what happens when the binding reference is absent?
Is the statement series complete and gap-free, and how are missing or duplicated statements detected?
Which parties may obtain a copy of the payment evidence, and on what lawful basis?
What is the current three-way match state between instruction, settlement confirmation and statement entry?
Which facts does this model hand to the accounting model, and which decisions does it deliberately not make?
How long has each reconciliation break been open, and what is the escalation threshold?
If a payment fact is later corrected, how is the previously produced posting handled?
Which regulatory regimes apply to this payment, and which jurisdictions triggered each of them?
Which jurisdictions did the payment touch through its parties, agents and settlement location?
Which originator and beneficiary information had to accompany the transfer, and was it complete on arrival?
When a regime's application date falls between instruction and settlement, which rules govern this payment?
Who may read a payment record by default, and which additional roles require an explicit grant?
What retention basis and period applies to each class of element, and which elements must be purged earliest?
How is a deletion obligation satisfied against an append-only settlement and event record that must remain intact?
Which elements are prohibited from storage after authorisation, and how is that prohibition enforced and tested?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier of this payment, which system assigned it, and in which namespace does it remain unique?
Which scheme end-to-end, instruction, transaction and UETR or equivalent identifiers travel with this payment so customer, PISP, ASPSP and rail records can be correlated?
Who assigned each identifier, at which event time, and was any Dimension UUID or ULID issued only after no master-system or governed global identifier existed?
Is this payment a credit transfer, direct debit, card, e-money, cheque, cash or another instrument class, and is it instant or non-instant?
Was the payment order initiated by the payer (push), by the payee under a mandate (pull), by a PISP on behalf of the payer, or by a request-to-pay accepted by the payer?
Which scheme or rail product governs the transfer, and is it domestic or cross-border given the residency of the payer's and payee's account-servicing institutions?
Which person or organization references are the payer and the payee, and under which role names (payer/payee versus originator/beneficiary versus debtor/creditor) are they recorded?
Is the account holder acting on behalf of an ultimate debtor or creditor, and which sibling party records identify those ultimate parties?
What country and structured address or town were supplied for payer and payee for travel-rule, TFR or scheme address rules, and is that data verified?
Which institutions act as debtor agent, creditor agent, intermediaries, PISP and settlement agent for this payment, in instructed order?
Is settlement serial through correspondent accounts or does a separate cover instruction exist, and which payment record is the cover?
Which agent is currently instructed to execute or settle, and under which scheme participation or license does it act?
What unique identifier, IBAN or other account scheme identifier was used to identify the payer account to debit and the payee account to credit?
If an alias or proxy (mobile number, email, PayID, VPA or similar) was used, what type and value were submitted and to which account identifier did the scheme resolve them?
Did the instructed name and account identifier identify the same person, and if they diverged, which identifier was the receiving bank obliged or permitted to rely on?
What amount and currency were instructed by the originator, and which monetary-unit or instrument record is referenced?
What amount and currency were actually settled or made available to the payee, and if they differ from instructed because of FX, charges or partial settlement, what remains?
If conversion occurred, what rate was applied, from which source, and at what event time versus the observation time of this record?
Who is contracted to bear PSP or rail charges for this payment (debtor, creditor, shared or each own), and is that choice allowed by the scheme?
What charge amounts, currencies and agents were deducted or billed, and do they appear as information on this payment or as a related fee payment?
After settlement, may charges be added that reduce the amount credited to the payee, or must any later fee be a new related transfer?
Which payment system or rail carried or will carry this transfer, who operates it, and is the payment on-us inside one PSP or off-us through a system?
Is clearing and settlement real-time gross, deferred net, hybrid, or bilateral correspondent, and is the settlement asset central-bank money, commercial-bank money or another claim?
Which scheme rulebook, FMI participation agreement and message standard bind this payment to the rail?
Is this payment's finality conditioned on another payment, a securities delivery or another obligation, and which record is the linked leg?
What rule makes settlement of this leg occur only if the other leg settles, and is principal risk thereby eliminated?
If the linked leg fails, is this payment rejected, held, unwound or settled independently?
When was the payment order issued and received by the receiving PSP, through which initiation channel, and what identifier does the order have distinct from the later FI-to-FI transaction?
Who was the sender of the order, was a PISP involved, and which payment instrument or procedure was used to initiate it?
What requested execution date or time did the sender give, and how does it relate to scheme cut-off and to the time of receipt that starts legal execution clocks?
Was this payment authorized by the payer, what authentication or security procedure was applied, and who holds the evidence?
If a PISP or other third-party provider initiated the order, what consent or access token authorized account access, and what was its scope and expiry?
Who bears the burden of proving authorization if the user disputes the payment, the ASPSP or the PISP, and has an unauthorized-claim flag been raised?
Does a direct-debit or other pull mandate authorize this payment, what is its identifier and status, and is this occurrence first, recurrent or last?
What maximum amount, creditor, account and expiry bound the mandate, and did this payment stay inside those bounds?
If a request-to-pay or creditor payment activation preceded this credit transfer, what is its identifier and status, and which payment was created in response?
Was verification of payee or confirmation of payee performed, what match result was returned, and at what event time?
If the check was a mismatch or close match, did the payer explicitly proceed, and was that choice recorded as an exception to straight-through processing?
Which directory or scheme API provided the match, and can the result be reused across rails or only within this scheme?
Has this payment reached legally defined final settlement, at what event time, and under which FMI or statute finality rule?
Which bank or FMI accepted the payment order, at what time, and by which acceptance mechanism (execution, credit, notification, system acceptance)?
Did this payment discharge or change a referenced monetary obligation (invoice, agreement or credit claim), in what amount, or is the transfer independent of any recorded underlying obligation?

What are the time of receipt, execution date, value date, funds-available time and final-settlement time, each with RFC 3339 seconds and offset where they are instants, and what is the observation or ingestion time of this record?
If the payment is instant, what SLA in seconds applied, was it met, and how many seconds elapsed from time of receipt to payee availability and to originator confirmation?
What settlement lag elapsed from system acceptance to final settlement, and did the payment miss value date?
What is the current transaction status and reason code, who reported it, and at what event time versus ingestion time?
Has a cancellation, recall or return been initiated against this payment, what reason was given, and which related payment record is the return?
What process window (scheme recall period, investigation deadline) still applies, and has a request for status update or investigation been opened?
Is the payment claimed as unauthorized, defective or late, who is liable among ASPSP and PISP, and has the payer been refunded?
What statutory or scheme refund or chargeback window applies, when does it close, and was the claim filed in time?
If a card or scheme chargeback exists, what reason code and evidence pack support it, and which related transfer effects the clawback?
Which originator and beneficiary information accompanied this transfer, was it verified before execution, and is the payload complete for the applicable FATF or TFR threshold?
What sanctions or restrictive-measures screening status applies, was the transfer rejected, suspended or frozen, and which hit reference supports that decision?
Which payer and payee countries and addresses travelled with the message, and did any PSP in the chain sit outside the jurisdiction that required the full payload?
What purpose and category-purpose codes were instructed, and do they match the scheme's allowed codes for this rail?
What remittance information or creditor reference accompanies the payment, and which invoice or agreement does it reference without inlining that claim?
Did remittance and purpose data survive the full agent chain unchanged, as required by the CPMI minimum data set, or was it truncated by an intermediary?
Which roles may inquire on this payment's status (payer, payee, PISP, ASPSP, rail operator, competent authority), and under what legal or scheme basis?
Was a status report, debit/credit advice or customer receipt issued, with which message type and at what event time?
Is an investigation or status-request case open, who opened it, and what is the current case state?
Who is the steward of this payment record (holder, ASPSP, rail operator), and who may authorize disclosure or correction?
From which source message or API assertion was this fact ingested, what hash or copy identifies that source, and what are event time versus ingestion time?
Until when must the payment and its authorization evidence be retained, is a legal hold in force, and which audit log records each read, exception access or deletion event?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
